### User problem
Who needs this and how do they currently solve it? Mark observed versus hypothesized.

### Smallest possible intervention
Could existing screens or offline functionality solve it without another tab, chat or notification?

### Impact
Free-use cost, offline behavior, personal privacy, device permissions, religious scholarly gates, accessibility and zero-open usefulness.

### Evidence and validation experiment

Core / later validated / future research. The maintainer will determine acceptance.
